meta.title: Career — Johan Nilsson
meta.description: From strategy consulting at EY and Cordial to Health & Fitness Nordic and SATS, and ten years with Barry’s in the Nordics, Iberia and Switzerland.

sections.label: Career

img.alt: Johan Nilsson at a desk in a studio

sections.quote: From the strategy desk <t>to the studio floor.</t>
sections.sub: Consulting, then strategy for the Nordic market leader, then ten years with Barry’s across the Nordics and beyond.

groups.label: Milestones
names: 2016 — Chief Executive Officer, Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB, Stockholm
2017 — The company’s first studio opens in Stockholm
2022 — Merger with BB Norway AS: eight studios in six Nordic cities, around 250 people
2022 — Barry’s Iberia: licence for Spain, with José Daniel García and Kevin Triguero
2023 — Partner and board member, Barry’s Iberia
2025 — Partner, Barry’s Switzerland: the first studio opens in Zürich in November

groups.label: In his words
names: “We share that vision for Barry’s future, and our role is more important than ever.” At the Nordic merger, 2022; translated from Swedish.
“Huge thanks to everyone who made this happen — it’s been an incredible team effort.” On Barry’s Helsinki, 2026.

sections.label: Openings & partnerships
sections.title: A decade of openings <t>and partnerships.</t>
sections.lede: Each one opened with a local partner and a studio team.

groups.label: Openings
names: Stockholm, 2017 — Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic’s first studio
Gothenburg — the company’s second Swedish city
Copenhagen — opened during the pandemic, before the 2022 merger
Barcelona and Madrid — Barry’s Iberia, under the licence of 2022
Zürich, November 2025 — the first Barry’s in Switzerland, with Julia Röthlisberger
Helsinki — Barry’s Nordic’s first studio in Finland

groups.label: The 2022 merger
names: Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB and BB Norway AS merge: eight studios in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Copenhagen, Oslo, Bergen and Sandvika, around 250 people

groups.label: Partners
names: Rasmus Elmann Ingerslev — Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic, chair of the board
Linn Herland and Tage Flugeim — co-owners of Barry’s Norway, merged in 2022
José Daniel García and Kevin Triguero — Barry’s Iberia, licence of 2022
Julia Röthlisberger — Barry’s Switzerland, 2025

sections.label: SATS · Health & Fitness Nordic
sections.title: Strategy for the Nordic <t>market leader.</t>
sections.lede: Five years in strategy and business development at the group behind SATS, before the move to operating and investing.

groups.label: Roles
names: Director, Strategy & Business Development, Health & Fitness Nordic — 2009–2014. A group with SEK 1.7 billion in revenue: SATS (Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland), Fresh Fitness (Norway, Denmark), Metropolis (Sweden) and SAFE (Sweden, Finland)
Strategy & Concept Director, SATS — 2014

sections.label: Timeline
sections.title: From EY, 1999, <t>to two boards in sport.</t>

groups.label: Consulting
names: Senior Consultant, Ernst & Young Management Consulting — 1999–2001
Strategy Manager, Telia Sverige — 2001–2002
Partner, Cordial Business Advisers — 2001–2009

groups.label: Investing
names: Founding Partner, Stockholm Leisure Partners — since 2015. An investor focused on the health and fitness industry; investments named in 2019 include Playbook App, ClassPass Nordics, REPEAT Fitness and Challengize

groups.label: Operating & investing
names: Partner, Barry’s Switzerland — Zürich, since May 2025
CEO & Partner, Barry’s Bootcamp Nordic AB — Stockholm
Partner & Board Member, Barry’s Iberia — since January 2023
Founding Partner, Stockholm Leisure Partners — since May 2015

groups.label: Boards in sport
names: Member of the Board (Ledamot, Förbundsstyrelsen), Svenska Innebandyförbundet — elected June 2026
Board Member, AIK — since March 2026
